# Preflight

> Pay-per-call smart-contract & transaction pre-flight security API. Submit
> Solidity source or a transaction for simulation and receive a severity-scored,
> signed security verdict. Paid per call via x402 (HTTP 402 + USDC on Base
> Sepolia testnet).

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | Price | Auth |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/` | free | none |
| GET | `/health` | free | none |
| GET | `/metrics` | free | none |
| POST | `/v1/scan` | $0.01 | x402 |
| POST | `/v1/sim` | $0.05 | x402 |
| POST | `/v1/scan/project` | $0.10 | x402 |
| POST | `/v1/address-risk` | $0.005 | x402 |

`/v1/sim` is transaction pre-flight simulation: give a target `to`, optional
0x-hex calldata `data`, and optional `value_wei`; get back a `SimReport` with
`reverted`, `revert_reason`, `gas_used`, and severity-scored findings (a
reverting call is a real finding, not a client error). `/metrics` exposes
revenue and usage counters (for example `revenue_base_units`) with no payment.

## Payment

- Network: `base-sepolia` (CAIP-2 `eip155:84532`)
- Asset: test USDC `0x036CbD53842c5426634e7929541eC2318f3dCF7e` (6 decimals)
- Scheme: `exact` (EIP-3009 transfer-with-authorization)
- Pay to: `0x3779bb827AB1F32A317fD30157Ac03Dc5CCA88aa`
- Facilitator: `https://x402.org/facilitator`

A paid route responds `402 Payment Required` with a `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header
containing the x402 payment requirements. Retry the same request with a
`PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` header carrying the signed payment payload. A successful
paid response carries a `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` header with the settlement result.

## Request bodies

`POST /v1/scan`:

```json
{
  "source": "pragma solidity ^0.8.20; contract Vault { ... }",
  "contract_name": "Vault",
  "solc_version": "0.8.20"
}
```

`POST /v1/sim`:

```json
{
  "to": "0x036CbD53842c5426634e7929541eC2318f3dCF7e",
  "data": "0xa9059cbb...",
  "value_wei": "0",
  "from_address": "0x...",
  "source": "pragma solidity ^0.8.20; contract Token { ... }"
}
```

Only `to` is required. `data` is 0x-hex calldata; omit it for a plain value
transfer. `source` is optional Solidity source for static honeypot detectors.

`POST /v1/scan/project`:

```json
{"files": {"Vault.sol": "pragma solidity ^0.8.20; contract Vault { ... }"}, "contract_name": "Vault"}
```

`POST /v1/address-risk`:

```json
{"address": "0x3779bb827AB1F32A317fD30157Ac03Dc5CCA88aa"}
```

## Response (ScanReport)

```json
{
  "verdict": "block",
  "score": 92.5,
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "reentrancy-no-eth",
      "title": "Reentrancy on withdraw()",
      "severity": "critical",
      "confidence": 0.98,
      "description": "External call before state update",
      "detector": "slither"
    }
  ],
  "contract_name": "Vault",
  "solc_version": "0.8.20",
  "scanned_at": "2026-11-10T00:00:00Z",
  "source_sha256": "0x...",
  "attestation": null
}
```

## Response (SimReport)

```json
{
  "verdict": "block",
  "score": 85.0,
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "sim:revert",
      "title": "Simulated call reverts",
      "severity": "high",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "description": "ERC20: transfer amount exceeds balance",
      "detector": "heuristic:simulation"
    }
  ],
  "to": "0x036CbD53842c5426634e7929541eC2318f3dCF7e",
  "from_address": "0x...",
  "value_wei": "0",
  "reverted": true,
  "revert_reason": "ERC20: transfer amount exceeds balance",
  "gas_used": "24312",
  "simulated_at": "2026-11-10T00:00:00Z",
  "simulator": "rpc-ethcall:v1",
  "attestation": null
}
```

## curl examples

```bash
# Service info + prices
curl https://dainius-raulinaitis--preflight-api-api.us-east.modal.run/

# Revenue/usage metrics (free)
curl https://dainius-raulinaitis--preflight-api-api.us-east.modal.run/metrics

# Dev-mode scan (no payment; server must run DEV_MODE=1)
curl -X POST https://dainius-raulinaitis--preflight-api-api.us-east.modal.run/v1/scan \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"source":"contract Bad {}","contract_name":"Bad"}'

# Paid loop, step 1: request -> 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED
curl -i -X POST https://dainius-raulinaitis--preflight-api-api.us-east.modal.run/v1/scan \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"source":"contract Bad {}"}'

# Paid loop, step 2: sign the requirements with x402.client, retry with
#   PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: <base64 signed x402 payload>
#   -> 200 + ScanReport + PAYMENT-RESPONSE (settlement tx)
curl -i -X POST https://dainius-raulinaitis--preflight-api-api.us-east.modal.run/v1/scan \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: <base64>' \
  -d '{"source":"contract Bad {}"}'

# The demo client performs the whole loop for you:
#   request -> 402 -> build payment via x402.client -> retry -> verdict
uv run python client/pay_client.py --route scan --file contract.sol
uv run python client/pay_client.py --route sim    # zero-arg revert demo
```

## MCP

An MCP server exposes paid `preflight_check {source, contract_name?}` ($0.01)
and `preflight_sim {to, data?, value_wei?}` ($0.05), plus free
`preflight_pricing`. Run it with `uv run python -m preflight.mcp.server`
(stdio) or `--http` for streamable HTTP.

## Dev mode

Set `DEV_MODE=1` on the API server to bypass payment locally.
